+@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{}], indirect=True)
+def test_get_pip_uses_current_interpreter(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    mocker.patch.object(pip, '_have_pip_module', return_value=True)
+
+    assert pip._get_pip(module) == [sys.executable, '-m', 'pip']
+    module.get_bin_path.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{}], indirect=True)
+def test_get_pip_executable_is_argv(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    mocker.patch.object(pip, '_have_pip_module', return_value=True)
+
+    assert pip._get_pip(module, executable='/usr/bin/pip') == ['/usr/bin/pip']
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{}], indirect=True)
+def test_get_packages_falls_back_to_freeze(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported option'), (0, 'six==1.0\n', '')]
+    mocker.patch.object(pip, 'get_best_parsable_locale', return_value='C')
+
+    command, stdout, stderr = pip._get_packages(module, [sys.executable, '-m', 'pip'], '/tmp')
+
+    assert command == '%s -m pip freeze' % sys.executable
+    assert stdout == 'six==1.0\n'
+    assert stderr == ''
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[0][0][0] == [sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'list', '--format=freeze']
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[1][0][0] == [sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'freeze']
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{}], indirect=True)
+def test_have_pip_module_handles_import_error(mocker):
+    mocker.patch('importlib.util.find_spec', side_effect=ValueError('broken import'))
+
+    assert not pip._have_pip_module()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('patch_ansible_module', [{}], indirect=True)
+def test_main_uses_virtualenv_bin_as_path_prefix(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.params = dict(state='present', name=['six'], version=None, requirements=None,
+                         extra_args=None, chdir=None, umask=None, virtualenv='/tmp/test-venv',
+                         executable=None, editable=False)
+    module.check_mode = False
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'Successfully installed six\n', '')
+    module.exit_json.side_effect = SystemExit
+    mocker.patch.object(pip, 'AnsibleModule', return_value=module)
+    mocker.patch.object(pip, '_get_pip', return_value=['/tmp/test-venv/bin/pip'])
+    mocker.patch.object(pip.os.path, 'exists', return_value=True)
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        pip.main()
+
+    assert module.run_command.call_args[1]['path_prefix'] == '/tmp/test-venv/bin'
+
+
